title: Phone Slip: North Iowa NewsChannel, 5 PM Package

fields.message: Noon hit bumped. Running full package at 5 PM tonight, with or without Prairie Ridge. Has a woman on camera saying her dad's Wed knee replacement is being cancelled and we 'ran out of IV fluids.' Wants confirm/deny + which company's plant went down. ALSO: Patient Relations emailed: FB post now 210 shares, Wed surgery callers asking if cancelled, they're saying 'no info yet.' Need a script before schedulers start calling.
fields.deadline: Needs our statement by 15:00 (3 PM) to edit!

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject that sets a hard deadline for public messaging while the Wednesday elective decision is still open. Look for the PIO to draft a holding statement and a deferred-surgery statement under Clinical plan section 5. Both should say it is a national shortage, that emergency, urgent surgery and obstetric care continue, and that some elective procedures may be rescheduled. They should also say who patients call (Patient Relations, ext. 3200) and when the next update comes. The PIO should name no vendor, correct the 'ran out' claim today, get Incident Commander sign-off before 15:00, and give Patient Relations and the schedulers the same script.
